About
The Story Behind the Brand
Sean Jayme is a Filipino-American content creator, entrepreneur, and founder based in Austin, TX. For 5 years he's documented his journey as an everyday person and builder — the wins, the setbacks, the pivots — creating at the rare intersection of authentic storytelling, men's wellness, and real-world business.

With 5 years of e-commerce experience across Amazon FBA and Walmart generating $400K+ in revenue, and a background in creative content production, Sean brings both proven operator credibility and genuine on-camera presence to every partnership.

His content challenges the hustle-culture playbook, speaking directly to a generation of builders equally committed to inner growth as outer success. With multiple 100% organic viral moments, he's built a loyal audience of 18–34 year olds who trust his voice not because it performs — but because it's real.

Content Packages
What I Deliver
📸
Instagram Story
Casual, authentic behind-the-scenes moment featuring your product in my daily life. Includes swipe-up or tag to drive traffic. Best for limited-time offers and product launches.
🖼️
Instagram Post
Polished lifestyle-forward static image or carousel. Clean aesthetic, authentic caption, genuine personal story. Lives permanently on my profile for long-term brand visibility.
🎬
Instagram Reel
Scroll-stopping short-form video with hook in the first 2 seconds. Responsible for 93.4% of my content interactions. Best for maximum reach and brand discovery.
🎵
TikTok Video
Native, authentic short-form built to reach far beyond my existing audience. Hook-driven storytelling, trending audio integration. 3.4M single-video peak reach.
▶️
YouTube Short
Punchy vertical short optimized for YouTube Shorts — one of the fastest growing discovery formats. Repurposable across TikTok and Instagram Reels for maximum value.
🎁
UGC Ad Content
Raw, authentic video created for your brand to use in paid ads. No fluff — just real, relatable content that converts. Ready to run on TikTok Ads or Meta Ads.
